utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Hana — I’ll keep an eye on the location details and pass along any updates if the repair drive moves.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Opal — please let me know the date, time, and what repairs are needed once you have them.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can check that for you—what details do you need about the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll spread the word about the repair drive right away. Folks around here usually pitch in when there’s a good cause.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yeah, I’ll spread the word and keep it practical — if you can help, could you mention it to a few neighbors?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can mention it, but I still need the date, time, and what repairs are needed first so I can pass along the right details.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good—just tell me what you still need, and I’ll help keep it moving.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’m all set on my end—just keep me posted if the repair drive changes, and I’ll bring whatever tools we need.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — just tell me what needs doing, and I’ll pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great — I’m keeping the supplies list organized, so tell me what you can bring or fix and I’ll track it down.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll keep spreading the word about the repair drive and let everyone know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Vik — that helps a lot. If anything opens up, I can coordinate a few more hands or supplies.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So you’ll actually spread the word about the repair drive, right?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’ll spread the word and share the updated Sunday time and community center location so everyone’s in the loop.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Nell — if you can keep track of who’s bringing what and let me know about any changes, that’d really help.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Of course — I’ll keep an eye on who’s bringing what and pass along any changes.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I’m still waiting on Eli to finalize the list and timing, then I’ll pass it along to everyone. If you hear any updates, send them my way.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Will do — I’m out running errands later, so if anything needs dropping off or picking up, I can help with the first batch.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good — I’ll keep the plan simple and let folks know exactly what we need.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Great, just let me know once the date, location, and supplies are set.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh—right, the repair drive. Just send me the updated list and timing, and I’ll help out.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely—I’ll send the updated list and timing right over.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yep, I’m still in for the repair drive this afternoon. Let me know if you want me to bring any tools.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Leo — I’m in to help too, just keeping it low-key for now. I don’t have the final repair details yet, but I’ll pass them along as soon as I do.
